device.name: Deep Robotics DR02 AMP locomotion (Isaac Lab training task)

facts.text: The DR02 AMP task is registered as Amp-Flat-Deeprobotics-DR02-v0 with entry point rl_training.envs:AmpLocomotionEnv and env config DR02AmpFlatEnvCfg
AmpLocomotionEnv.step applies the action through the action manager, then steps the simulation cfg.decimation times
AmpLocomotionEnv.step returns obs_buf, reward_buf, reset_terminated, reset_time_outs and extras
AmpLocomotionEnv.reset forwards to the base reset, resets the AMP helper and returns obs_buf with extras
The AmpLocomotionEnvCfg field only_positive_rewards defaults to True
AmpLocomotionEnv.step clips the total reward to a minimum of 0 when only_positive_rewards is true
The DR02 AMP config sets the joint-position action joint_names from DR02_DOF_ORDER and the per-joint action scale
DR02_DOF_ORDER lists the DR02 joint names in action order: left leg, right leg, waist, left arm and right arm
The AMP action config is a JointPositionActionCfg with use_default_offset, the clip (-10.0, 10.0), and preserve_order enabled
The observation groups are policy (73 dims), critic (121 dims), amp_obs_history (305 dims), obs_future (69 dims) and vel (3 dims)
The policy observation is [ang_vel(3), proj_grav(3), cmd(3), cmd_flag(1), dof_pos(21), dof_vel(21), actions(21)]
The AMP environment config sets decimation 4, episode_length_s 20.0 and sim.dt 0.005 s, with the comment naming 0.02 / decimation
The default scene config creates 4096 environments, so the upstream environment is vectorized
The README says rl_training is an IsaacLab-based RL training library and lists Amp-Flat-Deeprobotics-DR02-v0 as the DR02 environment
The README requires Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab 2.3.2 and Python 3.11 on Linux
The README tells users to deploy policies in MuJoCo or on real robots through a separate Deep Robotics deploy repository
The package install requirements list no serial, USB, VISA or ROS client library

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its placeholder kinematic update is deterministic; the upstream task's seed controls Isaac Lab's generators and physics, and GPU physics determinism was not established because the stack was not run

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no Isaac Sim/PhysX rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator, sensor, noise or rendering model; the fake's joint positions, velocities, reward and terminal flags are placeholders and do not reproduce the upstream MDP
the upstream environment is vectorized over 4096 environments in the default scene; the fake drives one environment, because the MHS Gymnasium bridge drives one

the upstream Gymnasium action space is built by Isaac Lab's action manager outside the clone; the fake uses an unbounded 21-element Box, so action.values is operator_required at the endpoint; the example site overlay is fake-scale test data, not a source-backed Gymnasium action space
the fake clips raw input to -10.0..10.0 as a placeholder; it does not reproduce the per-joint action scales, default joint offsets, or the external action manager's processing order
the fake returns all five configured observation groups with their upstream sizes (73, 121, 305, 69, 3), but every value is placeholder state, not an Isaac Lab observation

the fake truncates at 20 s / 20 ms = 1000 control ticks (from episode_length_s 20.0 and the 0.02 s control step) and never terminates; the upstream termination terms and timeout manager are not modelled

the upstream path is gym.make with Isaac Lab's env-config resolution, not the bare registered env_id; that path needs Isaac Sim 5.1.0 and Isaac Lab 2.3.2 and was not run, so no sim backend is declared

live construction also needs the Isaac application lifecycle, the configured assets and the deep_robotics_model submodule; the package does not serve the Lite3 rough-task entry on the card or any of the separate real-robot deployment paths
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state and the bridge has no declared checkpoint profile
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and the clock is lockstep

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

operator_required.name: cap_world_step_v1
operator_required.reason: the clone configures an internal JointPositionActionCfg clip but does not define the Gymnasium input Box; the operator supplies the input envelope, including for this R0 fake

safe_state.description: the analytic fake stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
